articles.title_en: Who Are the Hand-to-Mouth?
articles.title_cn: 谁是手到口？
articles.abstract_en: Many households hold little wealth. In standard precautionary savings models, these households should not only display higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) but also higher future consumption growth. In contrast, we see from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics that such “hand-to-mouth” households do not display higher growth in spending. They also exhibit greater volatility of spending and adjust their spending to a greater extent through the number of categories consumed. Consistent with a role for preference heterogeneity, the panel data show that it is persistent differences across households, not current assets, that predict low consumption growth and other spending differences for the hand-to-mouth households. To identify the extent of preference heterogeneity, we consider the model of Kaplan and Violante with both liquid and illiquid assets, but allow heterogeneity in preferences. To match the data, many poor hand-to-mouth must be relatively impatient and have a high inter-temporal elasticity of substitution. The model shows that preferences predominantly explain the higher MPCs for low-asset households. Preference heterogeneity notably increases the spending impact of fiscal transfers, but only if targeted, while reducing that from interest rate cuts.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多家庭几乎没有什么财富。在标准的预防性储蓄模型中，这些家庭不仅应该表现出更高的边际消费倾向（MPC），而且还应该表现出更高的未来消费增长。相比之下，我们从收入动态面板研究中看到，这些“勉强糊口”的家庭并没有表现出更高的支出增长。他们还表现出更大的支出波动性，并通过消费类别的数量更大程度地调整支出。与偏好异质性的作用一致，面板数据显示，家庭之间的持续差异，而不是流动资产，预测了勉强糊口的家庭的低消费增长和其他支出差异。为了确定偏好异质性的程度，我们考虑了具有流动性和非流动性资产的 Kaplan 和 Violante 模型，但允许偏好的异质性。与数据相匹配的是，不少勉强糊口的穷人一定是比较缺乏耐心，并且具有很高的跨期替代弹性。该模型表明，偏好主要解释了低资产家庭较高的 MPC。偏好异质性显着增加了财政转移支付的支出影响，但前提是有针对性，同时降低了降息的支出影响。

articles.title_en: Expectations and Learning from Prices
articles.title_cn: 期望和从价格中学习
articles.abstract_en: We study mislearning from equilibrium prices, and contrast this with mislearning from exogenous fundamentals. We micro-found mislearning from prices with a psychologically founded theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), where traders learn fundamental information from prices, but fail to realize others do so too. PET leads to over-reaction, and upward sloping demand curves, thus contributing to more inelastic markets. The degree of individual-level over-reaction and the extent of inelasticity vary with the composition of traders, and with the informativeness of new information. More generally, unlike mislearning from fundamentals, mislearning from prices (i) generates a two-way feedback between prices and beliefs that can provide an arbitrarily large amount of amplification and (ii) can rationalize both over-reaction and more inelastic markets. The two classes of biases are not mutually exclusive. Instead, they interact in very natural ways, and mislearning from prices can vastly amplify mislearning from fundamentals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究均衡价格的错误学习，并将其与外生基本面的错误学习进行对比。我们通过基于心理学的“部分均衡思维”（PET）理论微观地发现了对价格的错误学习，交易者从价格中学习基本信息，但没有意识到其他人也在这样做。 PET 会导致过度反应和向上倾斜的需求曲线，从而导致市场更加缺乏弹性。个人层面过度反应的程度和缺乏弹性的程度因交易者的构成以及新信息的信息量而异。更一般地说，与对基本面的错误学习不同，对价格的错误学习（i）会在价格和信念之间产生二方式的反馈，可以提供任意大量的放大，并且（ii）可以使过度反应和缺乏弹性的市场合理化。 二类别的偏见并不相互排斥。相反，它们以非常自然的方式相互作用，对价格的错误学习可能会极大地放大对基本面的错误学习。

articles.title_en: Survey Data and Subjective Beliefs in Business Cycle Models
articles.title_cn: 经济周期模型中的调查数据和主观信念
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a theory of subjective beliefs that departs from rational expectations, and shows that biases in household beliefs have quantitatively large effects on macroeconomic aggregates. The departures are formalized using model-consistent notions of pessimism and optimism which are supported by extensive time-series and cross-sectional evidence from household surveys. The role subjective beliefs play in aggregate fluctuations is quantified in a business cycle model with goods and labour market frictions. Consistent with the survey evidence, an increase in pessimism generates upward biases in unemployment and inflation forecasts and lowers economic activity. The underlying belief distortions reduce aggregate demand and propagate through frictional goods and labour markets. As a by-product of the analysis, solution techniques that preserve the effects of time-varying belief distortions in the class of linear solutions are developed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一种偏离理性预期的主观信念理论，并表明家庭信念的偏差对宏观经济总量有很大的影响。这些偏离是使用与模型一致的悲观主义和乐观主义概念来形式化的，这些概念得到了来自家庭调查的广泛时间序列和横截面证据的支持。主观信念在总体波动中所起的作用在包含商品和劳动力市场摩擦的商业周期模型中进行了量化。与调查证据一致，悲观情绪的增加导致失业率和通胀预测上调，并降低经济活动。潜在的信念扭曲减少了总需求，并通过摩擦性商品和劳动力市场传播。作为分析的副产品，开发了保留线性解类中随时间变化的置信度扭曲影响的解法技术。

articles.title_en: Job Applications and Labour Market Flows
articles.title_cn: 工作申请和劳动力市场流动
articles.abstract_en: Job applications have risen over time, yet job-finding rates remain unchanged. Meanwhile, separations have declined. We argue that increased applications raise the probability of a good match rather than the probability of job-finding. Using a search model with multiple applications and costly information, we show that when applications increase, firms invest in identifying good matches, reducing separations. Concurrently, increased congestion and selectivity over which offer to accept temper increases in job-finding rates. Our framework contains testable implications for changes in offers, acceptances, reservation wages, applicants per vacancy, and tenure, objects that enable it to generate the trends in unemployment flows.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着时间的推移，求职申请不断增加，但求职率保持不变。与此同时，离职率有所下降。我们认为，申请的增加会提高良好匹配的可能性，而不是找到工作的可能性。使用具有多个应用程序和昂贵信息的搜索模型，我们表明，当应用程序增加时，公司会投资于识别良好的匹配，从而减少分离。与此同时，工作机会的拥挤度和选择性的增加导致了求职率的上升。我们的框架包含对录取、录取、保留工资、每个空缺申请人和任期的变化的可测试影响，这些变化使其能够产生失业流动的趋势。

articles.title_en: Gang Rule: Understanding and Countering Criminal Governance
articles.title_cn: 帮派统治：理解并应对犯罪治理
articles.abstract_en: Criminal groups govern millions worldwide. Even in strong states, gangs resolve disputes and provide security. Why do these duopolies of coercion emerge? Often, gangs fill vacuums of official power, suggesting that increasing state presence should crowd out criminal governance. We show, however, that state and gang rule can be strategic complements. In particular, gangs could minimize seizures and arrests by keeping neighbourhoods orderly and loyal. If true, increasing state presence could increase incentives for gang rule. In Medellín, Colombia, criminal leaders told us they rule to protect drug rents from police. We test gang responses to state presence using a geographic discontinuity. Internal border changes in 1987 assigned blocks to be closer or further from state security for three decades. Gangs exogenously closer to state presence developed more governance over time. They primarily did so in neighbourhoods with the greatest potential drug rents. This suggests new strategies for countering criminal governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 犯罪集团在全球范围内治理着数百万人。即使在强国家中，帮派也会解决争端并提供安全保障。为什么这种强制权力的双寡头会出现？通常，帮派填补了官方权力的真空，这意味着增加国家存在本应挤出犯罪治理。然而，我们表明，国家统治与帮派统治也可能构成战略互补。具体而言，帮派可以通过维持社区秩序和忠诚，减少被查缴和逮捕的风险。如果这一点成立，增加国家存在反而可能提高帮派统治的激励。在哥伦比亚麦德林，犯罪头目告诉我们，他们进行统治是为了保护毒品租金不被警方夺取。我们利用地理不连续性检验帮派对国家存在的反应。1987年的内部边界变化，使一些街区在此后三十年内距离国家安全力量更近或更远。外生地更接近国家存在的帮派，随时间推移发展出更多治理活动；他们主要在潜在毒品租金最高的社区这样做。这为应对犯罪治理提供了新的策略。

articles.title_en: Imagining the Future: Memory, Simulation, and Beliefs
articles.title_cn: 想象未来：记忆、模拟和信念
articles.abstract_en: How do people form beliefs about novel risks, with which they have little or no experience? Motivated by survey data on beliefs about COVID we collected in 2020, we build a model based on the psychology of selective memory. When a person thinks about an event, different experiences compete for retrieval, and retrieved experiences are used to simulate the event based on how similar they are to it. The model predicts that different experiences interfere with each other in recall and that non-domain-specific experiences can bias beliefs based on their similarity to the assessed event. We test these predictions using data from our COVID survey and from a primed-recall experiment about cyberattack risk. In line with our theory of similarity-based retrieval and simulation, experiences and their measured similarity to the cued event help account for experience effects, priming effects, and the interaction of the two in shaping beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们如何对自己很少或根本没有经验的新风险形成信念？受我们在 2020 中收集的有关新冠病毒信念的调查数据的启发，我们建立了一个基于选择性记忆心理学的模型。当一个人思考一个事件时，不同的经历会竞争检索，并且检索到的经历会根据它们与该事件的相似程度来模拟该事件。该模型预测，不同的经历在回忆过程中会相互干扰，并且非特定领域的经历可能会因其与评估事件的相似性而使信念产生偏差。我们使用来自新冠肺炎调查和有关网络攻击风险的启动召回实验的数据来测试这些预测。根据我们基于相似性的检索和模拟理论，经验及其与提示事件的测量相似性有助于解释经验效应、启动效应以及二在塑造信念时的相互作用。

articles.title_en: Inflation Levels and (In)Attention
articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀水平和关注
articles.abstract_en: Inflation expectations are key determinants of economic activity and are central to the current policy debate about whether inflation expectations will remain anchored in the face of recent pandemic-related increases in inflation. This article explores evidence of inattention by constructing two novel and direct measures of consumers’ inattention, and documents greater attention when inflation is high. This relationship can explain a substantial portion of the flattening of the Phillips curve and also suggests the possibility of upward attention-price spirals.
articles.abstract_cn: 通胀预期是经济活动的关键决定因素，也是当前政策辩论的核心，即面对近期与大流行相关的通胀上升，通胀预期是否仍将保持稳定。本文通过构建二新颖且直接的消费者注意力不集中衡量标准来探索注意力不集中的证据，并记录了通货膨胀高时人们的注意力会受到更大程度的关注。这种关系可以解释菲利普斯曲线平坦化的很大一部分，也表明注意力价格螺旋式上升的可能性。

articles.title_en: Market Structure and Extortion: Evidence from 50,000 Extortion Payments
articles.title_cn: 市场结构和勒索：来自 50,000 勒索付款的证据
articles.abstract_en: How does gang competition affect extortion? Using detailed data on individual extortion payments to gangs and sales from a leading wholesale distributor of consumer goods and pharmaceuticals in El Salvador, we document evidence on the determinants of extortion payments and the effects of extortion on firms and consumers. We exploit a 2016 non-aggression pact between gangs to examine how collusion affects extortion in areas where gangs previously competed. While the pact led to a large reduction in competition and violence, we find that it increased the amount paid in extortion by approximately 20%. Much of this increase was passed through to retailers and consumers: retailers experienced an increase in delivery fees, leading to an increase in consumer prices. In particular, we find an increase in prices for pharmaceutical drugs and a corresponding increase in hospital visits for chronic illnesses. The results point to an unintended consequence of policies that reduce competition between criminal organisations.
articles.abstract_cn: 帮派竞争如何影响敲诈勒索？利用萨尔瓦多一家领先的消费品和药品批发分销商向帮派支付的个人勒索款项以及销售的详细数据，我们记录了勒索款项的决定因素以及勒索对公司和消费者影响的证据。我们利用帮派之间的 2016 互不侵犯条约来研究勾结如何影响帮派以前竞争的地区的勒索行为。虽然该协议大大减少了竞争和暴力，但我们发现它使敲诈勒索金额增加了大约 20%。这一增长大部分转嫁给了零售商和消费者：零售商的送货费增加，导致消费者价格上涨。特别是，我们发现药品价格上涨，慢性病住院人数相应增加。结果表明，减少犯罪组织之间竞争的政策会产生意想不到的后果。

articles.title_en: Does Pricing Carbon Mitigate Climate Change? Firm-Level Evidence from the European Union Emissions Trading System
articles.title_cn: 碳定价能减缓气候变化吗？来自欧盟排放交易系统的公司级证据
articles.abstract_en: In theory, market-based regulatory instruments correct market failures at least cost. However, evidence on their efficacy remains scarce. Using administrative data, we estimate that, on average, the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS)—the world’s first and largest market-based climate policy—induced regulated manufacturing firms to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by 14–16% with no detectable contractions in economic activity. We find no evidence of outsourcing to unregulated firms or markets; instead, firms made targeted investments, reducing the emissions intensity of production. These results indicate that the EU ETS induced global emissions reductions, a necessary and sufficient condition for mitigating climate change. We show that the absence of any negative economic effects can be rationalized in a model where pricing the externality induces firms to make fixed-cost investments in energy-saving capital that reduce marginal variable costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 理论上，基于市场的监管工具可以以最小的成本纠正市场失灵。然而，关于其功效的证据仍然很少。使用行政数据，我们估计，平均而言，欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）——世界上的第一和最大的基于市场的气候政策——促使受监管的制造企业将二氧化碳排放量减少了14-16%，而经济活动没有出现明显的收缩。我们没有发现外包给不受监管的公司或市场的证据；相反，企业进行了有针对性的投资，降低了生产的排放强度。这些结果表明，欧盟排放交易体系促进了全球减排，这是减缓气候变化的充分必要条件。我们表明，在一个模型中，没有任何负面经济影响可以被合理化，在该模型中，对外部性进行定价会促使企业对节能资本进行固定成本投资，从而降低边际可变成本。

articles.title_en: Employer Credit Checks: Poverty Traps Versus Matching Efficiency
articles.title_cn: 雇主信用检查：贫困陷阱与匹配效率
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to understand pre-employment credit screening as a signal from credit markets that alleviates adverse selection in labour markets. In our theory, people differ in both their propensity to default on debt and the profits they create for firms that employ them; in our calibrated economy, highly productive workers have a low default probability. This leads firms to create more jobs for those with good credit, which creates a poverty trap: an unemployed worker with poor credit has a low job finding rate, but cannot improve her credit without a job. This manifests as an endogenous loss in present-discounted wages that is typically taken as exogenous in quantitative models of consumer default. Banning employer credit checks eliminates the poverty trap, but pools job seekers and reduces matching efficiency: average unemployment duration rises by 2 days for high productivity workers and falls by 13 days for low-productivity workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架，将就业前信用筛选理解为来自信贷市场的信号，可以减轻劳动力市场的逆向选择。在我们的理论中，人们的债务违约倾向和为雇用他们的公司创造的利润都不同。在我们经过校准的经济中，高生产率的工人违约概率较低。这导致企业为信用良好的人创造更多的就业机会，这就造成了贫困陷阱：信用较差的失业工人的就业率很低，但没有工作就无法提高其信用。这表现为当前贴现工资的内生损失，在消费者违约定量模型中通常被视为外生损失。禁止雇主信用检查消除了贫困陷阱，但集中了求职者并降低了匹配效率：高生产率工人的平均失业持续时间增加了 2 天，低生产率工人的平均失业持续时间下降了 13 天。

articles.title_en: What Good Are Treatment Effects Without Treatment? Mental Health and the Reluctance to Use Talk Therapy
articles.title_cn: 不治疗的话治疗效果有什么好处？心理健康和不愿使用谈话疗法
articles.abstract_en: Evidence across disciplines suggests that talk therapy is more curative than antidepressants for mild-to-moderate depression and anxiety. Yet, few patients use it. We develop a dynamic choice model to analyse patient demand for the treatment of depression and anxiety. The model incorporates myriad potential impediments to therapy use along with links between mental health improvements and earnings. The estimated model reveals that mental health improvements are valuable, directly through utility and indirectly through earnings. However, patient reluctance to use therapy is nearly impervious to reasonable counterfactual policies (e.g. lowering prices or removing other costs). Patient behaviour might reflect stigma, biases in beliefs about the effectiveness of therapy, or a distaste for discussing personal or painful issues with a stranger. More broadly, the benefits of therapy estimated in randomized trials tell only half the story. If patients do not use treatments outside of an experimental setting—and we fail to understand why or how to get them to—estimated treatment effects cannot be leveraged.
articles.abstract_cn: 跨学科的证据表明，对于轻度至中度抑郁和焦虑，谈话疗法比抗抑郁药物更有效。然而，很少有患者使用它。我们开发了一个动态选择模型来分析患者对抑郁和焦虑治疗的需求。该模型包含了治疗使用的无数潜在障碍以及心理健康改善和收入之间的联系。估计模型表明，心理健康的改善是有价值的，直接通过效用，间接通过收入。然而，患者不愿使用治疗几乎不受合理的反事实政策（例如降低价格或消除其他成本）的影响。患者的行为可能反映了耻辱感、对治疗有效性信念的偏见，或者不喜欢与陌生人讨论个人或痛苦的问题。更广泛地说，随机试验中估计的治疗效果只说明了一半。如果患者不使用实验环境之外的治疗方法（而我们无法理解为什么或如何让他们这样做），则无法利用估计的治疗效果。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Online Competition on Local Newspapers: Evidence from the Introduction of Craigslist
articles.title_cn: 在线竞争对当地报纸的影响：来自 Craigslist 推出的证据
articles.abstract_en: How does competition from online platforms affect the organization, performance, and editorial choices of newspapers? What are the implications of these changes for the information voters are exposed to and for their political choices? We study these questions using the staggered introduction of Craigslist (CL)—the world’s largest online platform for classified advertising—across U.S. counties between 1995 and 2009. This setting allows us to separate the effect of competition for classified advertising from other changes brought about by the Internet, and to compare newspapers that relied more or less heavily on classified ads ex ante. We find that, following the entry of CL, local newspapers reliant on classified ads experienced a significant decline in the number of management and newsroom staff, including in the number of editors covering politics. These organizational changes led to a reduction in news coverage of politics and resulted in a decline in newspaper readership, particularly among readers with high political interest. Finally, we document that reduced exposure to local political news was associated with an increase in partisan voting and increased entry and success of ideologically extreme candidates in congressional elections. Taken together, our findings shed light on the determinants of the decline of print media and on its broader implications for democratic politics.
articles.abstract_cn: 在线平台的竞争如何影响报纸的组织、表现和编辑选择？这些变化对选民接触的信息和他们的政治选择有何影响？我们通过在 1995 和 2009 之间在美国各县交错引入 Craigslist (CL)（世界上最大的分类广告在线平台）来研究这些问题。这种设置使我们能够将分类广告竞争的影响与互联网带来的其他变化区分开来，并在事前比较或多或少依赖分类广告的报纸。我们发现，在CL进入之后，依赖分类广告的当地报纸的管理层和新闻编辑室人员数量显着下降，包括报道政治的编辑数量。这些组织变化导致政治新闻报道减少，并导致报纸读者数量下降，特别是对政治感兴趣的读者。最后，我们证明，减少对当地政治新闻的接触与党派投票的增加以及意识形态极端候选人在国会选举中的进入和成功有关。总而言之，我们的研究结果揭示了印刷媒体衰落的决定因素及其对民主政治的更广泛影响。

articles.title_en: Optimal Pricing of a New Utility Service: The Case of Piped Water in Vietnam
articles.title_cn: 新公用事业服务的最优定价：越南自来水案例
articles.abstract_en: As utility services expand throughout the developing world, providers must grapple with how to set prices to recover average costs. Data from a multiyear randomised pricing experiment among nearly 1,500 recently connected piped water customers in Vietnam reveal month-to-month demand persistence. Based on structural demand estimation, we document how endogenous preferences, if unaccounted for, can lead to low take-up and thereby threaten the financial viability of the new water utility. We also show that such demand persistence calls for pricing schemes that defer lump-sum payment, effectively allowing future consumers to subsidise their present selves.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着公用事业服务在发展中国家的扩展，提供商必须努力解决如何定价以收回平均成本的问题。对越南近 1,500 个最近连接的自来水客户进行的多年随机定价实验的数据显示了每月的需求持续性。根据结构性需求估计，我们记录了如果不考虑内生偏好，会如何导致使用率低，从而威胁新水务公司的财务生存能力。我们还表明，这种需求持续性需要推迟一次性付款的定价方案，从而有效地允许未来的消费者补贴现在的自己。

articles.title_en: Consumption Quality and Employment Across the Wealth Distribution
articles.title_cn: 财富分配中的消费质量和就业
articles.abstract_en: In the U.S., market hours worked are approximately flat across the wealth distribution. Accounting for this phenomenon is a standing challenge for standard heterogeneous-agent macro models. In these models, wealthier households consume more and work fewer hours. We propose a theory that generates the cross-sectional wealth-hours relation as in the data. We quantify this theory in a heterogeneous-agent incomplete-markets model with three key features: a quality choice in consumption, non-homothetic preferences, and a multi-sector production structure. We show that the model produces consumption expenditure patterns consistent with the data and realistic “quality Engel curves”.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，市场工作时间在财富分布上大致持平。解释这种现象是标准异构主体宏观模型面临的长期挑战。在这些模型中，富裕家庭消费更多，工作时间更少。我们提出了一种理论，可以生成数据中的横截面财富-时间关系。我们在异质代理不完全市场模型中量化了这一理论，该模型具有三关键特征：消费的质量选择、非相似偏好和多部门生产结构。我们表明，该模型产生的消费支出模式与数据和现实的“质量恩格尔曲线”一致。

articles.title_en: “You Will:” A Macroeconomic Analysis of Digital Advertising
articles.title_cn: “你会的：”数字广告的宏观经济分析
articles.abstract_en: An information-based model is developed where traditional and digital advertising finance the provision of free media goods and affect price competition. Digital advertising is directed toward specific consumers while traditional advertising is undirected. The equilibrium is suboptimal. Media goods, if valued by the consumer, are under provided with both types of advertising. Additionally, traditional advertising is excessive because it is undirected. The tax-cum-subsidy policy that overcomes these inefficiencies is characterized. The model is calibrated to the U.S. economy. Through the lens of the calibrated model, digital advertising increases welfare significantly. The welfare gain from the optimal policy is much smaller than the gain from digital advertising.
articles.abstract_cn: 开发了一种基于信息的模型，其中传统和数字广告为免费媒体商品的提供提供资金并影响价格竞争。数字广告是针对特定消费者的，而传统广告是无定向的。平衡不是最理想的。如果消费者重视媒体商品，则两种类型的广告都不会提供。此外，传统广告是过度的，因为它是无定向的。克服这些低效率的税收和补贴政策的特点是。该模型针对美国经济进行了校准。通过校准模型的镜头，数字广告显着增加了福利。最优政策带来的福利收益远小于数字广告带来的收益。

articles.title_en: Motivated Skepticism
articles.title_cn: 动机怀疑
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally study how individuals read strategically transmitted information when they have preferences over what they will learn. Subjects play disclosure games in which Receivers should interpret messages skeptically. We vary whether the state that Senders communicate about is ego-relevant or neutral for Receivers, and whether skeptical beliefs are aligned or not with what Receivers prefer believing. Compared to neutral settings, skepticism is significantly lower when it is self-threatening, and not enhanced when it is self-serving. These results shed light on a new channel that individuals can use to protect their beliefs in communication situations: they exercise skepticism in a motivated way, that is, in a way that depends on the desirability of the conclusions that skeptical inferences lead to. We propose two behavioural models that can generate motivated skepticism. In one model, the Receiver freely manipulates his beliefs after having made skeptical inferences. In the other, the Receiver reasons about evidence in steps and the depth of his reasoning is motivated.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究当个人对自己将要学习的内容有偏好时，他们如何阅读策略性传输的信息。受试者玩揭露游戏，其中接收者应该怀疑地解释消息。我们会改变发送者所传达的状态对于接收者来说是与自我相关的还是中立的，以及怀疑的信念是否与接收者更喜欢相信的一致。与中立环境相比，自我威胁时的怀疑态度明显较低，而自私时的怀疑态度并未增强。这些结果揭示了一个新的渠道，个人可以用它来保护自己在交流情境中的信念：他们以一种有动机的方式行使怀疑态度，也就是说，以一种取决于怀疑性推论所得出的结论的可取性的方式。我们提出二可以产生有动机的怀疑的行为模型。在一模型中，接收者在做出怀疑性推论后自由地操纵他的信念。另一方面，接收者对证据进行逐步推理，并且推理的深度是有动机的。

articles.title_en: A Structural Analysis of Mental Health and Labour Market Trajectories
articles.title_cn: 心理健康和劳动力市场轨迹的结构分析
articles.abstract_en: We analyse the joint life-cycle dynamics of labour market and mental health outcomes while allowing for two-way interactions between work and mental health. We model selection into jobs on a labour market with search frictions, accounting for the level of exposure to stress in each job using data on occupational health contents. Taking our model to British data from Understanding Society combined with information from O*NET, we estimate the impact of job characteristics on health dynamics and the effects of health and job stress contents on career choices. We use our model to quantify the effects of job loss, health shocks, or job stress shocks that propagate over the life cycle through both health and work channels. We also estimate the (large) values workers attach to health, employment, or nonstressful jobs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了劳动力市场和心理健康结果的联合生命周期动态，同时考虑到工作和心理健康之间的二方式相互作用。我们对劳动力市场上存在搜索摩擦的工作选择进行建模，并使用职业健康内容数据来解释每项工作的压力水平。将我们的模型结合来自 Understanding Society 的英国数据以及来自 O*NET 的信息，我们估计了工作特征对健康动态的影响以及健康和工作压力内容对职业选择的影响。我们使用我们的模型来量化失业、健康冲击或工作压力冲击通过健康和工作渠道在生命周期中传播的影响。我们还估计了工人对健康、就业或无压力工作的重视程度。

articles.title_en: Market Power and Price Informativeness
articles.title_cn: 市场力量和价格信息
articles.abstract_en: We study the distributional effects of asset ownership on price informativeness in a general equilibrium model. The model features investors (oligopolists) with different degrees of price impact and abilities to learn about individual asset payoffs from private and price signals, and a competitive fringe that only learns from asset prices. We show that price informativeness is non-monotonic in the oligopolists’ aggregate size, decreasing in the sector’s concentration and in the size of the passive sector. We further show that the size effect can be decomposed into a learning channel capturing investors’ quality of private signals and an information pass-through channel measuring the sensitivity of investors’ trades to private signals, with the latter one being the primary source of variation in price informativeness relative to the size distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一般均衡模型中研究资产所有权对价格信息性的分配效应。该模型的特点是投资者（寡头垄断者）具有不同程度的价格影响力和从私人信号和价格信号中了解个人资产收益的能力，以及仅从资产价格中学习的竞争边缘。我们表明，价格信息量在寡头的总规模中是非单调的，随着行业集中度和被动行业规模的增加而下降。我们进一步表明，规模效应可以分解为捕获投资者私人信号质量的学习渠道和衡量投资者交易对私人信号敏感性的信息传递渠道，后者一是相对于规模分布的价格信息变化的主要来源。

articles.title_en: The Lifetime Costs of Bad Health
articles.title_cn: 健康状况不佳的终生成本
articles.abstract_en: What generates the observed differences in economic outcomes by health? How costly it is to be unhealthy? We show that health dynamics are largely driven by ex-ante fixed heterogeneity, or health types, even when controlling for one’s past health history. In fact, health types are the key driver of long spells of bad health. We incorporate these rich health dynamics in an estimated structural model and show that health types and their correlation with other fixed characteristics are important to account for the observed gap in economic outcomes by health. Monetary and welfare losses due to bad health over the life-cycle are large, concentrated, and to a large extent due to factors pre-determined earlier in life. A large portion of the related monetary costs is due to income losses, especially for people of working age, while a substantial portion of the welfare losses arises because health affects life expectancy.
articles.abstract_cn: 是什么导致了所观察到的健康经济结果差异？不健康的代价有多大？我们表明，即使在控制一过去的健康史的情况下，健康动态很大程度上也是由事前固定的异质性或健康类型驱动的。事实上，健康类型是长期健康状况不佳的关键驱动因素。我们将这些丰富的健康动态纳入估计的结构模型中，并表明健康类型及其与其他固定特征的相关性对于解释观察到的健康经济结果差距非常重要。生命周期中因健康状况不佳而造成的金钱和福利损失是巨大的、集中的，并且在很大程度上是由于生命早期预先确定的因素造成的。相关货币成本的很大一部分是由于收入损失，特别是对于工作年龄的人来说，而福利损失的很大一部分是由于健康影响预期寿命而产生的。

articles.title_en: Should We Prevent Off-Label Drug Prescriptions? Empirical Evidence from France
articles.title_cn: 我们应该防止超说明书用药吗？来自法国的经验证据
articles.abstract_en: After a drug obtains marketing authorisation, the usage depends on the regulation of off-label prescriptions for unapproved indications. We investigate the impact of off-label prescription regulation on physicians’ behaviour, patients’ health, treatment costs, and pharmaceutical firms’ pricing with a structural demand and supply model. Exploiting rich panel data on physicians’ activities and office visits in France over 9 years, we use a model of prescription choice and health outcomes with unobserved patient-level heterogeneity. We identify the demand for on-label and off-label drugs and the effect of prescription choice on health outcomes. On the supply side, we use a Nash-in-Nash bargaining model between the government and the pharmaceutical companies that allows the partial identification of the marginal costs of drugs. Counterfactual simulations show that when we remove off-label drugs from the choice set of physicians, substitution to on-label drugs at constant prices would lead to an increase of 15% in the expenditure on prescription drugs. If we allow bargaining adjustment on drug prices under a ban on off-label prescriptions, the ban would further increase the treatment cost, by 26%, without improving health outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 药品获得上市许可后，其使用取决于对未批准适应症的超说明书处方的监管。我们通过结构性供需模型研究了标签外处方监管对医生行为、患者健康、治疗成本和制药公司定价的影响。利用法国9年来医生活动和就诊的丰富面板数据，我们使用了处方选择和健康结果模型，且未观察到患者层面的异质性。我们确定对标签内和标签外药物的需求以及处方选择对健康结果的影响。在供应方面，我们在政府和制药公司之间使用纳什中纳什讨价还价模型，该模型允许部分确定药品的边际成本。反事实模拟表明，当我们从医生的选择集中删除标签外药物时，以不变价格替代标签上药物将导致处方药支出增加15%。如果我们允许在禁止标签外处方的情况下对药品价格进行讨价还价调整，该禁令将进一步增加治疗成本26%，而不会改善健康结果。
